items.title: Wordmark
items.about: a wordmark in thin wide-tracked 3D letters, with an optional rule and a small line under it
items.prompt: My brand name 'CONNECT AI LAB' as thin gold 3D letters with a small line under it, on a black mirror floor.

objects.sub: The most beautiful way to learn AI

items.title: Monogram
items.about: the CONNECT mark as a sculpture: an open ring, a node and a link (the material swatch of this catalog)
items.prompt: Our mark as a gold sculpture on a small black pedestal, turning slowly, teal light behind.

items.title: Studio building
items.about: a small studio building: lit windows, a lobby, and your sign on the roof
items.prompt: A small studio building at night with lit windows and the sign 'CONNECT AI LAB' on the roof.

items.title: Camera
items.about: a mirrorless cinema camera with a prime lens and a blinking record light; tripod optional
items.prompt: My camera on its tripod, record light blinking, in a bright studio.

items.title: Microphone
items.about: a broadcast microphone with a wire grille and a gold band, on a desk stand or a boom arm
items.prompt: A broadcast microphone on a desk stand, lit from behind in red and gold.

items.title: Workstation
items.about: a compact aluminium desktop computer with a soft status light
items.prompt: A compact aluminium desktop computer on a black mirror, a soft blue light behind.

items.title: Display
items.about: a studio display on a stand; shows your image ("src") or a title card
items.prompt: A studio display on its stand showing a title card: 'CONNECT AI LAB'.

items.title: Laptop
items.about: an open laptop; the screen shows your image ("src") or a title card
items.prompt: An open laptop on an ivory desk; my title on its screen.

items.title: Softbox
items.about: a studio softbox on a light stand: shows where your key light is
items.prompt: A studio softbox on its stand lighting ivory letters from the side.

items.title: Clapperboard
items.about: a film clapperboard with your title; the stick claps at "clapAt" seconds
items.prompt: A film clapperboard with my title that claps once.

items.title: Course book
items.about: a hardcover course book with your title on the cover
items.prompt: A hardcover course book, 'VISUAL VIBE CODING', standing in teal light.

items.title: Primitives
items.about: box, sphere, cylinder, cone, capsule, torus
items.prompt: Build our mark from six basic shapes: an open ring, a ball, a rod, on a stem and a block, with a small lamp pointed at it.

items.title: Flat shapes
items.about: plane, disc and ring: plates, floor marks, thin rules
items.prompt: A round stage mark on the floor, a tall teal plate behind, our gold mark standing on it.

items.title: Rounded box
items.about: box with soft edges that catch the light
items.prompt: Three rounded slabs as a plinth, the course book standing on top, turning slowly.

items.title: Torus knot
items.about: one endless knot: a classic for trophies and material tests
items.prompt: A trophy: a gold knot on a black base with my name on the plate.

items.title: Gem
items.about: faceted gem: icosa, octa or dodeca cut
items.prompt: The letters 'AI' in ivory with three glass gems floating around them like crystals.

items.title: 3D text
items.about: extruded letters in six built-in typefaces (thin, light, sans, bold, serif, serif-bold)
items.prompt: The words 'Visual Vibe Coding' as gold serif 3D letters, a slow sway, reflected on the floor.

items.title: 3D text, letter by letter
items.about: split:true makes each letter its own object
items.prompt: The name 'AI MENTOR JAY' arriving one ivory letter at a time, teal light behind.

items.title: Text label
items.about: thin sans text that is always crisp
items.prompt: A small wide-spaced line 'CONNECT AI LAB' with a thin headline under it.

objects.text: The most beautiful way to learn AI

items.title: Glass card
items.about: frosted panel with a kicker, a title and a gold rule
items.prompt: Three frosted glass cards: 'Say it', 'One spec', 'Web + video', rising in turn.

items.title: Image plane
items.about: your own picture on a framed plane
items.prompt: My screenshot on a tilted black-framed panel that slides in from the right.

items.title: Mirror floor
items.about: black floor that reflects the scene
items.prompt: My camera and my microphone standing on a black mirror floor.

items.title: Grid floor
items.about: thin lines fading into the distance
items.prompt: A drawing-board view: the studio building as a gold wireframe over an endless thin grid.

items.title: Shadow catcher
items.about: an invisible floor that only shows the shadow
items.prompt: Big black letters 'JAY' standing in a bright studio with a soft shadow under them.

items.title: Fat line
items.about: lines that keep their width and can draw themselves
items.prompt: Three thin orbits in gold, ivory and teal drawing themselves around our mark.

items.title: Ribbon
items.about: a solid tube along a curve that draws itself
items.prompt: A gold ribbon sweeping once around my microphone.

items.title: Gyro rings
items.about: metal rings turning around a core
items.prompt: A gyroscope of gold and steel rings turning around our small ivory mark.

items.title: Instances: wave grid
items.about: hundreds of copies in one draw call, moving as a wave
items.prompt: A sea of small teal discs rippling under the gold wordmark.

items.title: Instances: sphere
items.about: copies laid out on a sphere, ring, spiral or scatter
items.prompt: A shell of small gold gems turning around the ivory letters 'AI'.

items.title: Instances: spiral
items.about: the same mesh along a spiral
items.prompt: Gold coins climbing a spiral around my course book.

items.title: Dot globe
items.about: a globe of dots with arcs that draw themselves
items.prompt: A dark globe made of dots, gold arcs connecting places one by one; teal rim.

items.title: 3D bars
items.about: a bar chart from your own numbers
items.prompt: My four numbers as 3D bars growing one by one, teal with the biggest in gold.

items.title: Night city
items.about: procedural night skyline: building silhouettes in haze, a few lit windows, roof beacons; one draw call for the buildings
items.prompt: A night skyline: dark towers in haze, a few lit windows, red lights on the roofs; the camera slides sideways.
items.source: CONNECT AI LAB shader on InstancedMesh

items.title: Back glow
items.about: a soft pool of light on the wall behind the subject
items.prompt: A soft teal pool of light on the wall behind my camera, like a night studio set.

items.title: Terrain
items.about: ridged ground from our own noise, optional wire
items.prompt: Dark mountains with a faint blue wire, our studio building standing on the plain, the camera rising.

items.title: Rolling surface
items.about: a dark moving surface with coloured crests
items.prompt: A dark sea rolling slowly under our gold mark, teal light on the crests.

items.title: Group
items.about: several objects that move, stagger and explode together
items.prompt: My desk as one group: display, computer, microphone and book move apart and come back together.

items.title: glTF model
items.about: your .glb or .gltf: fitted, grounded, animated by time
items.prompt: Load my astronaut.glb, stand it on the mirror floor beside our wordmark, turn it slowly.

items.title: SVG logo in 3D
items.about: your .svg extruded into a solid object
items.prompt: Extrude my logo.svg into thick ivory and let it turn like a medal, red light behind.

items.title: Sky
items.about: physical sky with a sun
items.prompt: The studio building outdoors under a real sky, low sun, long shadows.

items.title: Liquid metal blob
items.about: metaballs that merge and split
items.prompt: A blob of liquid chrome hovering over my open laptop, splitting and merging.

items.title: Teapot
items.about: the Utah teapot, the hello-world of 3D
items.prompt: The classic teapot in ivory sitting on my desk next to the display.

items.title: Parametric surface
items.about: mobius band or klein bottle
items.prompt: A gold mobius band turning like a halo above my workstation.

items.title: Contact shadow
items.about: a soft dark pool under an object so it sits on the floor instead of floating
items.prompt: My cinema camera on a dark pedestal, with a soft shadow where it touches the floor, slow turn.

items.title: billboard

items.about: move toward or away from the target
items.prompt: Push in slowly toward the microphone.

items.about: rise or sink while looking at the target

items.prompt: Light my microphone only from behind in gold, so just the edges show.

items.title: 3D on your own video
items.about: transparent 3D over your footage; with a person matte the 3D goes BEHIND you, and keep-out boxes guard your face and your mic arm
items.prompt: On my talking video: when I say '3D modeling', show our mark as a wireframe on my right and turn it into solid gold, then slide a computer out from behind my head. Never cover my face or my mic.
